english.title: Fail to keep authorisations and operators licence for international regular bus service in the vehicle
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) operated an international regular passenger service, namely **(..DESCRIBE SERVICE..), using a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY MAKE AND REG..), and failed to keep in that vehicle the authorisation, or a certified true copy thereof, to carry out international regular services and the operator's licence, or a certified true copy thereof, for the international carriage of passengers by road in breach of Article 15(1) of the RSR Protocol
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 16(1)(b) and 18 of the Road Transport (International Passenger Services) Regulations 2018.
